newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan shipowners seek new shipping policy.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan shipowners seek new shipping policy.

text.p: Pakistan's National Shipowners Association said on Wednesday it had urged Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's government to formulate a new policy to promote the shipping industry.

The government should order government institutions to pay freight to Pakistani shipping companies on the same terms as they do in the case of foreign shipping companies, association president Masood Baghpatee said in a letter to the government.
The policy would create healthy competition to boost the shipping industry, he said.
In the public sector, the state-run Pakistan National Shipping Corp owns 17 ships.
The government issued 40 licences to Pakistani companies in the past five years to operate shipping services but only three of them bought ships, a shipping company executive said.
